overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to convene on October 26, 2026, to address a zoning change request, review municipal operations reports, and consider contract renewals for legal services. The meeting was set to handle routine financial matters and a significant land-use decision affecting a residential property on Aspen Road.

agenda.item: Finance Director/Treasurer Report: Projected Closure Dates for Tax Increment Districts
Vouchers, ACH Transactions, and Credit Card Activity Transactions – September 2026
Zoning Change Request from Jean Pochinski

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider a zoning change request for 2.89 acres located at 3115 Aspen Road, Kronenwetter. The property, identified by Parcel ID 145-2708-212-0987, was set for discussion regarding reclassification from RR5 (Rural Residential 5) to RR2 (Rural Residential 2) zoning designation.

discussions.item: Finance Director/Treasurer Report: Projected Closure Dates for Tax Increment Districts
discussions.body: The Finance Director was scheduled to present a report on projected closure dates for tax increment districts. This report was expected to provide updates on the financial planning and timeline for TID closures affecting the village.

The board was set to discuss and take possible action on municipal center hours of operation. This agenda item was scheduled for discussion and potential decision-making regarding facility operations.
The board was scheduled to discuss and potentially act on Ordinance 14-16. Specific details regarding the ordinance content were not provided on the published agenda.

The board was expected to consider renewal of legal services for the three-year period from 2027 through 2029. This agenda item was set for discussion and possible action regarding the village's legal representation contract.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda, scheduled for up to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time period per person, at the discretion of the Chief Presiding Officer.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on zoning change request for 3115 Aspen Road
Expected to consider operator bartender license for Dennie Wiedeman

title: Revised Village Board Meeting - 2026-10-26
